summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Option Agreement granting it a call option to acquire 100% of G3 Vision Labs Inc. from CentralLarkfieldKarin NA LLC, Venkata Boyapalli, and a trust, which would make G3 and its subsidiaries (Med Screen, Dominion, Acutis) direct or indirect subsidiaries. The option is conditional on Profusa raising at least $30 million in gross proceeds, refinancing G3's indebtedness, stockholder approval of a Preferred Stock Conversion Proposal and Nasdaq Proposal, and maintaining Nasdaq listing. Terms such as price per share or premium were not disclosed. Watch for financing commitments and shareholder vote as key conditions to exercise.
